summary.name: LoopCV
summary.one_liner: LoopCV is an AI job search automation platform that auto-applies to matching jobs using your uploaded CV, and can also email recruiters.
use_cases: Mass applying to matching jobs each day
Emailing recruiters with a personalised template
A/B testing CV versions to see which gets replies
Tracking job applications in one place
Auto-filling job application forms with AI
Improving a CV with a checker and builder
summary.what_it_does:
LoopCV lets you upload a CV, set job titles and locations, and then searches multiple job platforms for new postings each day. It can submit applications automatically, either through application forms (ATS) or by emailing recruiters found for the company, or you can review matches manually first. It provides analytics such as email opens, replies and which CV versions perform best, and supports A/B testing of CVs. Extra tools mentioned include a CV Checker, a CV Builder, filters, company exclusion and job application tracking.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Auto-applies to jobs on LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor and 30+ platforms, per the meta description
Finds recruiter emails and sends personalised outreach from templates
A/B tests CV versions with analytics on opens, replies and CV performance
Optional manual review before any application is sent
caveats: Higher application volumes and features require paid tiers; current pricing is on a separate pricing page
Number of applications per day depends on plan limits and filters
The claim of 3x more interviews is stated by the vendor; results vary by role, market and CV quality
